literal_meaning: দম (শ্বাস) এবং সম (সমান বা অবস্থা) – শ্বাসকষ্টের অবস্থা
figurative_meaning_en: A state of discomfort or breathlessness from overeating
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিয়ের ভোজে এত খেয়ে দমসম হয়ে গেছে।
অতিরিক্ত খাবার খেয়ে সে দমসম অবস্থায় পড়ে আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He ate so much at the wedding feast that he's feeling out of breath.
After overindulging in food, she was in a state of discomfort from being stuffed.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali traditions of lavish feasts during festivals and weddings, highlighting the physical toll of hospitality.
